judged_text: poll_feed runs `TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: url).first` plus a SHA1/full import attempt inside a loop over every feed item — an N+1 query pattern over an unbounded collection. A feed with hundreds of items issues hundreds of individual lookups and up to hundreds of PostCreator/topic transactions inside one Sidekiq job with no batching (a single IN/join lookup would serve the membership test), so runtime grows linearly with feed size on the hottest path of the feature and a large feed stalls the hourly job.

A feed with hundreds of items issues hundreds of individual lookups and up to hundreds of PostCreator/topic transactions inside one Sidekiq job with no batching (a single IN/join lookup would serve the membership test), so runtime grows linearly with feed size on the hottest path of the feature and a large feed stalls the hourly job.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, `rss.items.each` calls `TopicEmbed.import` per feed item. `TopicEmbed.import` performs `TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: url).first` for each item and may run a full `Topic.transaction` + `PostCreator` create path per item when missing, so a large feed will trigger one DB lookup per item (and potentially many writes) within a single scheduled Sidekiq job. This is a diff-grounded linear-scaling/performance concern (N+1 style) rather than a functional correctness bug.
